function: system: learned synthesis of regional CIR magnitude from building maps (area 2), but one omnidirectional transmit antenna to single-antenna receive points, no RIS (p. 8, p. 9).
notes: Exclude, reason system. Research article (not survey); the learned PIDRTN/PIDRTN-A (U-Net based, supervised on ray-tracing labels) generates the CIR magnitude of every grid point of a region from the building height map, i.e. channel synthesis/estimation of area 2, so no_learning, above_phy and function do not apply. The link is single antenna at both ends and has no RIS: p. 4: "This study considers each antenna element as an ideal omnidirectional antenna"; p. 4, eq. (1): the CIR of each point is a sum of scalar path coefficients; p. 8: "a transmitting antenna is deployed at the center of the scenario with an output power of 5 W and a frequency of 28 GHz"; p. 9: "512 x 512 receiving points are uniformly arranged". MIMO is only motivation and future work: p. 11: "In future work, we will further investigate the estimation of MIMO channel matrices"; p. 12: "ultimately facilitate the acquisition of MIMO channel matrices". Quantitative NRMSE results exist (p. 12), so results would not apply. If the reviewer judges that a learned ray-tracing surrogate (propagation modeling) is not channel synthesis of area 2, the first reason would be function instead of system.
